title: Ransomware encrypts file servers and backups
vulnerability: Backups on same domain; no immutability; flat network
planned_controls: Immutable/offline backups; segmentation; EDR; restore tests

title: Business email compromise / account takeover
vulnerability: MFA gaps on admins and VPN; legacy auth not blocked
existing_controls: MFA for most staff; spam filter
planned_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for admins; Conditional Access; block legacy auth

title: Client PII exposed through SaaS vendor breach
planned_controls: Vendor security questionnaire; SOC 2 review; DPA clauses

title: Lost/stolen laptop with client data
vulnerability: Some laptops not enrolled in BitLocker
planned_controls: Intune compliance policy requiring encryption; remote wipe

title: Extended outage at main site
vulnerability: Single ISP; no tested recovery plan
planned_controls: Secondary ISP; documented and tested DR runbook

title: Delayed breach notification triggers penalties
vulnerability: No IR plan or notification templates
planned_controls: IR plan; legal retainer; notification templates

title: Cyber insurance claim denied
planned_controls: Validate attestations; close MFA/EDR gaps before renewal
